description: Gets the current local date and time.
name: get_current_time

description: Gets the absolute path of a standard system folder.
name: get_known_folder_path

folder_name.description: The name of the folder to query. Supported values: 'desktop', 'documents', 'downloads'.

description: Writes the specified text content to a file. It creates the file if it does not exist, and overwrites it if it exists.
name: write_to_file

content.description: The text content to write to the file.

path.description: The full path of the file to write to, e.g., 'C:/Users/User/Desktop/example.txt'
